summary: Frontend-only regression of the shared scroll-lock (lib/scrollLock.js) across all overlays, doctor (medico@mantmed.it) and parent portal (genitore.demo@example.com), desktop 1920x800 + iPhone emulation 390x844 with real CDP touch swipes. Method: window.scrollTo(Y) -> open via element.click()/pointerdown in evaluate -> check body.style.position=='fixed', body.style.top=='-Ypx', html overflow hidden -> mouse wheel over window (inner scrollTop must grow) and over the dark backdrop (nothing moves) -> close (Esc / backdrop click / close btn) -> scrollY==Y and body styles cleared -> page wheel works again. PASSED: Cos'e MantAI (doctor + portal; 92vh, inner scroll 0->1708, backdrop click closes), Home visit-detail Sheet, doctor profile menu (real click + outside click/Esc), Ctrl+K global search, Sicurezza e GDPR panel (inner scroll 0->1191), ConsultationOverlay (opened, closed without recording), Scheda paziente/Passport overlay (inner scroll 0->3693) + nested 'Modifica' PatientDialog (dialog 736px <= 800, scrolls 0->198, passport and page stay still, wheel on scrim moves nothing, scrim click closes only the dialog, passport stays locked, closing passport restores y=350 exactly), Passaporto e FSE -> 'Vedi come il genitore' preview (inner scroll, passport behind unchanged), Bodychart editor (from passport visit -> note -> bodychart, inner scroll 0->756, consultation behind still locked until it is closed), portal bell popover (inner 0->1609), portal profile menu, Richiedi appuntamento dialog (0->383), Condividi con un medico (informativa scrolls internally, closed without creating any share), Scheda emergenza (closed without saving). Hover menus in the top bar (Pazienti, Messaggi, Area personale) open (aria-expanded=true) and do NOT lock: body.position stays '' and the page wheel-scrolls normally. Mobile: 'Altro' drawer locks (top -400px), vertical swipe moves nothing, tapping the backdrop closes it and restores y exactly (doctor + portal). Mobile dialog: swipe scrolls the dialog to its bottom, extra swipes at the bottom do not move the page, swipe down scrolls back. Horizontal swipe on the Passport tab strip inside the overlay still works (scrollLeft 0->547) and the page stays still. The guided tour (bar button, fresh page) still scrolls the page and positions correctly. ONE BUG FOUND: 'Rivedi tour' started from the profile menu while the page is scrolled -> tour opens while the dropdown lock is still active, so its window.scrollTo does nothing; the card ends up off-screen (top -212px portal / -312px doctor) and 'Salta il tour' cannot be reached. No visual changes seen in colors, fonts or content.

ui_bugs.component: GuidedTour + ProfileMenu (doctor TopBar profile-tour, portal ProfileMenu 'Rivedi tour')
ui_bugs.issue: Steps: scroll the page (y=300/400), open the profile menu, click 'Rivedi tour'. The tour opens while the DropdownMenu ScrollLock is still active (close animation). useTargetRect calls window.scrollTo, which does nothing because body is position:fixed and html is overflow:hidden. It then sets scrolled.current=key, so it never tries again. unlockScroll then puts the page back to y=300. Result: the step-1 card is drawn at top -212px (portal) / -312px (doctor). The video, title and 'Salta il tour' are off-screen and the tour can't be closed by mouse. Starting the tour from the bar button on a fresh page works: it scrolls to 0 and the card sits at top 88px.

Probably an older bug (not confirmed separately): the scrolled ref is not reset when the tour closes. If the tour is opened a second time on the same page from a scrolled position, step 1 has the same key, so the scroll is skipped and the card is again off-screen. Seen after a menu-started tour: the bar-button tour then showed card top -312px with scrollY unchanged.

issues: Data di nascita uses the browser's native date input rather than the shadcn calendar. This was already there and is not part of this change.

action_items: Fix the tour starting from the profile menu while the page is scrolled. In GuidedTour useTargetRect, if isScrollLocked() is true, do not set scrolled.current and retry on a later tick (or put the scroll in a short timeout after unlock). Another option: in ProfileMenu onTour, wait for the menu to close before calling tour.start (e.g. setTimeout(start, 0) after onCloseAutoFocus, or check !isScrollLocked()).
Reset scrolled.current = '' in useTargetRect when the tour closes or opens (when active turns false), so a second opening on the same page scrolls the first target into view again.

Optional: lockScroll does not add padding-right to make up for the scrollbar width. On desktops with classic scrollbars (Windows) the content behind a dialog/popover can shift by about 15px. This could not be checked in headless Chrome, which uses overlay scrollbars.
critical_code_review_comments: scrollLock.js: the design is solid (counter for nested windows, saved cssText restored, Lenis stop/start + resize + immediate scrollTo, touchmove allowed only when an ancestor can still scroll that way, horizontal gestures allowed). Nested Passport -> PatientDialog and Passport -> Preview behaved correctly.

Any code that calls window.scrollTo / scrollIntoView while a lock may be active will do nothing silently, as in the tour. Consider exporting a helper that queues the scroll until unlockScroll (e.g. an onUnlock callback list).

Because popover, select and dropdown now lock the page, any feature that opens a non-modal popover and expects the page to keep scrolling is affected. Only the top-bar hover menus were confirmed to be excluded (they do not lock).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (about 22 overlay flows passed; 1 failed: tour started from the profile menu)

seed_data_creation: None. No shares, emergency cards, appointments, feedback or patient edits were saved. All dialogs were closed without submitting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use element.click() via page.evaluate to open overlays. Playwright's click scrolls the element into view, and the doctor TopBar is not sticky, so locator clicks at a scrolled position move the page or fail with 'outside of viewport'. Open Radix DropdownMenus with a dispatched pointerdown event (bubbles:true, button 0, pointerType 'mouse') on the trigger. Passport overlay: /app/pazienti -> patient-card-* (opens the inline folder) -> patient-folder-passport-btn. Aurora Ricci = patient-card-6ad86e64c06e50ff4cd67d1e, with long content. Tabs: passport-tab-visite / passport-tab-passaporto (portal preview = passport-portal-preview-btn). Bodychart: passport-visit-open-* -> note-bodychart-btn. For touch, use a new context (is_mobile, has_touch) plus a CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent swipe. To retest the tour bug: scroll to 300, open the profile menu, click 'Rivedi tour', and check the tour-card bounding box top is >= 0.
rca of the issue: Tour bug: ProfileMenu item onSelect -> tour.start() runs while the DropdownMenuContent (which renders <ScrollLock/>) is still mounted during its exit animation, so count > 0. In GuidedTour.useTargetRect the first rAF tick finds the target above the viewport and calls window.scrollTo({top:0, smooth}). With html overflow:hidden and body position:fixed this does nothing. scrolled.current is set straight away, so the tour never tries again. When the menu unmounts, unlockScroll restores window.scrollTo(saved.y), which keeps the page scrolled. place() then works from a negative rect.top, which pushes the card off-screen. Mitigation: skip or postpone the tour scroll while isScrollLocked(), or start the tour after the menu has closed.
